bio:
Howdy! I'm John. Software engineer by trade. But I love other things like pixelart, TTRPGs, metal, synths, idm, bitwig, books, anime/manga, 
80s and early 90s sci-fi/cyberpunk. I live in Decatur, GA with my wife and two kids. 

So I started longlostforgotten about 25+ years ago, maybe? It's taken on many different forms, but started out originally as a livejournal (heh). It's a place to log all of my ramblings, musings, and other odd bits that cross my mind.
